title: Ready when
subtitle: This document is designed to be shared with your team and used to support your Lily Foundation grant proposal. Here's how to move forward.

steps.heading: Share this with your team
steps.body: Review the platform overview and investment summary with your leadership team and board. Your husband's familiarity with HubSpot will help frame the comparison — DonorDock is the same architecture, built for nonprofit fundraising rather than B2B sales. Same mental model. Better fit for your work.

steps.heading: Name DonorDock in your Lily Foundation proposal
steps.body: This document provides the platform overview, pricing, and organizational rationale you need for your grant narrative. If you need a letter of intent, additional technical specifications, or any supporting materials for the application, reach out — we're glad to support it directly.

steps.heading: Come back when you're ready to move
steps.body: No pressure to engage before funding is in place. When the grant comes through, DonorDock will be ready. We're rated #1 Easiest Setup on G2 — most teams are fully live in days, not months. Your 90-day onboarding program means you'll have a dedicated team from day one.
